title: Exact Hom and K-flat ordinary dual for a strictly perfect local complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules that is strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Use the actual Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex] and the ordinary unit $S=\mathcal O_U[0]$, dual $D_P=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,S)$ and tensor models of [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. Then for all arbitrary complexes $M,M'$ and every quasi-isomorphism $t:M\to M'$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], the actual induced map $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,t)$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Moreover $D_P$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], meaning that $\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes D_P)$ is acyclic for every acyclic $F$. No bound is imposed on $M,M'$ or $F$.

proof.text: For each term A=P^n choose a finite free retract A -> B -> A. Internal Hom from B preserves short exact sequences by finiteFreeInternalHomExact. Precomposition with the projection and inclusion gives a retract of the Hom short complex for A from that for B. Its homology is a retract of zero, so it is zero; its first and second arrows are retracts of a monomorphism and an epimorphism. Thus it is short exact. These arguments are the private proved helpers shortExact_of_retract and exact_homObj_of_finiteFree_retract.
Use the bounds on P and the exact-term conclusion of step 1 in quasiIso_homComplex_map_of_bounded_exact_terms. This proves preservation of all quasi-isomorphisms by the actual Hom(P,-) functor.

Let F be acyclic. The zero complex Z is acyclic, hence 0:Z -> F is a quasi-isomorphism. Each product factor in each term of Hom(P,Z) is zero, because the target term of Z is zero. The Hom product limit detects equality with zero, so Hom(P,Z) is acyclic. Apply step 2 to 0:Z -> F; quasiIso_iff_acyclic then makes Hom(P,F) acyclic.

Construct f:Tot(F tensor D_P) -> Hom(P,F) with localEvaluationDegreeMap and its differential identity; localEvaluationDegreeMap_formula supplies the specified ordinary evaluation predicate. Every degree is invertible by isIso_localOrdinaryEvaluation_degree. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components gives an isomorphism of complexes.

Transport exactness in each degree of Hom(P,F) through the inverse chain isomorphism from step 4. This proves acyclicity of Tot(F tensor D_P) for every acyclic F, which is the definition of K-flatness.

theorem strictlyPerfect_localHom_computations (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
    (hstrict : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U P) :
    (∀ (M M' : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) (t : M ⟶ M'),
      QuasiIso t → QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := X.sheaf.over U)).obj (op P)).map t)) ∧
      (localEvaluationDual X U P).IsAcyclicTensorKFlat
